ledger.x: 1071: after Manzikert the Seljuk Turks take Theodosiopolis (Erzurum); the Saltukid beylik is founded.
1077: the Byzantines reoccupy Erzurum ('Erzurum was briefly reoccupied by the Byzantine Empire between 1077 and 1079').
1079: the Byzantine reoccupation of Erzurum ends ('between 1077 and 1079').
Undated, placed at 1132 (Izz al-Din Saltuk becomes malik): 'At its height' the beylik held 'the entirety of present-day Erzurum and Bayburt provinces' and 'most of Kars Province'.
ledger.cp: holder not named by the page

ledger.x: 1202: the Seljuks of Rum end the Saltukids.
1202: the beylik is annexed by the Sultanate of Rum.

wars.name: Saltukid wars with Georgia
wars.outcome: Izz al-Din was defeated and captured by Georgians under Dimitri I in 1154 (ransomed by the Artuqid Sökmen); in 1161 he and Turkish allies besieged the Georgians at Ani and were defeated; George III besieged Erzurum in 1184; the city 'repelled many attacks by…

wars.name: Rum conquest of Erzurum
wars.outcome: Süleymanshah II 'put an end to the Saltuqids' in 1202 (1201 on the Erzurum page).

certainty.note: Provinces stand for the beylik; the Georgian frontier on the Kars side moved with the wars and no line is given.
